question: 各知识库分别有多少文档
sql_raw: SELECT kb.name AS 知识库名称, COUNT(d.id) AS 文档数 FROM knowledge_bases kb LEFT JOIN documents d ON d.kb_id = kb.id AND d.status = 'COMPLETED' GROUP BY kb.id, kb.name
sql_final:
SELECT
  kb.name AS 知识库名称,
  COUNT(d.id) AS 文档数
FROM knowledge_bases AS kb
LEFT JOIN documents AS d
  ON (
    d.kb_id = kb.id AND d.status = 'COMPLETED'
  ) AND d.org_id = 65
WHERE
  kb.org_id = 65
GROUP BY
  kb.id,
  kb.name
LIMIT 200

steps.note: 命中 3 张表（白名单共 4 张）
注入租户谓词：kb.org_id = 65、d.org_id = 65；注入 LIMIT 200
已附最终 SQL 与判定链路
